name: bdd
description: Behaviour-Driven Development toolkit: turn a one-line requirement into Gherkin, review it as an HTML spec report, sketch the UI the features imply - every data state of each page - on a wireframe canvas before any code exists, scaffold cucumber with Playwright for web and Appium for mobile, drive each scenario to green with outside-in TDD against per-feature planning files, run the suite with requirement coverage, derive page and screen flow maps from run screenshots, and generate database DDL from Gherkin.
